KEGG ORA performs pathway over-representation analysis from a foreground gene list and a pathway mapping. It reports one row per pathway with foreground hits, pathway size, universe size, hypergeometric upper-tail p-value, and Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value.

Use a supplied or pinned mapping table for reproducible analyses, fixed database snapshots, or organisms/databases that are not directly supported by an installed Galaxy enrichment wrapper. KEGG REST mode can download a current KEGG organism mapping when network access is available to the Galaxy job.

The p-value adjustment family can be all pathways with at least one gene in the universe, or only pathways with at least one foreground hit.
